purpose: Golden cases are for qualitative demonstration and debugging only (live demo, screenshots, explanation examples, final presentation). The quantitative evaluation source is benchmark/replay.

primary.subject: Поставка компьютерного оборудования

temporal_history.rule: facts with publish_date < target publish_date only

descriptive_difficulty.note: Historical award-count statistic (P1-001A §9 definition). NOT a Supplier Radar recommendation result.

primary.why_selected: Generic lot title hides a precise laptop model in the ТРУ line; 13 observed suppliers; very common category (large candidate pool).

demo_story.evidence: ТРУ line «Ноутбук Acer Aspire 5 A515-57-50R7 15.6"» (OKPD2 26.20.11.110) — model number + screen size
demo_story.expected_capability: Retrieval and explanation driven by item-level evidence (model tokens, OKPD2) rather than the generic subject.

primary.subject: Поставка кресел в ГБОУ СОШ № 358 Московского района Санкт-Петербурга
representative_product_names: Кресло офисное Бюрократ CH-695NLT, Материал обивки сетка , ткань, Цвет обивки черный, Минимальная высота сиденья 445 мм, Максимальная высота сиденья 540 мм , Внутренняя ширина сиденья 480 мм, Глубина

temporal_history.rule: facts with publish_date < target publish_date only

descriptive_difficulty.note: Historical award-count statistic (P1-001A §9 definition). NOT a Supplier Radar recommendation result.

primary.why_selected: Long, concrete specification (brand, model, dimensions, load, warranty) for an everyday object; 14 observed suppliers; the winner sits mid-pack by simple historical award counts — ranking is not trivial.

demo_story.input: Lot 5545252 — office chairs for a St Petersburg school
demo_story.evidence: ТРУ line «Кресло офисное Бюрократ CH-695NLT …» with seat height, width, load and warranty attributes (OKPD2 31.01.11.150)
demo_story.expected_capability: Explain why suppliers are relevant using item text + OKPD2 + history, and show that simple award counts alone are not enough.

primary.subject: Поставка перчаток смотровых (процедурных) нитриловых

temporal_history.rule: facts with publish_date < target publish_date only

descriptive_difficulty.note: Historical award-count statistic (P1-001A §9 definition). NOT a Supplier Radar recommendation result.

primary.why_selected: Clear medical consumable; 15 observed suppliers; the eventual winner had only one prior same-code award — demonstrates the limits of history-only ranking and the need for transparent evidence.

demo_story.evidence: ТРУ line «Перчатки смотровые/процедурные нитриловые, неопудренные, нестерильные» (OKPD2 22.19.60.119)
demo_story.expected_capability: Show the evidence behind each candidate honestly, including when the eventual winner has thin history.
